title: Agency banking terminal and field-operator safeguards
workflow: Verify agent contract, device, cash limits and institution permission
Authenticate customer and validate action and allowed channel
Collect proposed deposit/withdrawal instruction with unique command ID
Record actual cash custody handover under approved dual controls
Commit only through authorized online financial domain and show true outcome
Reconcile teller cash, receipt and ledger before closing agent session
invariants: Offline terminal cannot fabricate completed financial posting
Agent cannot operate beyond contractual product and liquidity limits
Agent cash balance is a custody record distinct from customer deposit liability
Do not declare settlement from unconfirmed network response
Per-agent privilege expiry and suspension must be effective immediately
Receipts must identify customer operation status accurately
Duplicate retry cannot create duplicate customer balances
acceptance_tests: Offline deposit presented as pending not completed
Repeat terminal request uses one ledger command
independent_gate: Bank agency licensing and contract requirements, approved cash custody policy and executed agent reconciliation tests.
